Football Uniform Questions

How long does it take to produce custom football uniforms?

Design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks and express DDP delivery in 3-7 days. Plan 4-6 weeks from artwork to delivered uniforms.

Can I get custom football jerseys in 15 days?

Yes on a rush schedule, approving the digital mockup instead of a physical sample - 10-12 days production plus 3-5 days express shipping. Tell us your first game date when you enquire.

How do I design custom football uniforms?

Send a logo, sketch or photo of your current kit. We return a front-and-back mockup of jersey and pants within 48 hours at no charge, including numbers, names and shoulder treatments, with free revisions.

What is the minimum order for custom football uniforms?

20 sets per design. Tackle and flag football cuts count toward the same minimum, and youth through adult sizes mix freely in one order.

How much do custom football jerseys cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Our published pricing page lists sublimated sports jerseys from $18.00 at 20 sets, falling 10-40% at higher volumes; pants and tackle twill work are itemised separately.
